title: EvidenceLifecycleEvent
description: PROGRAM-006 (ADR-008). Immutable, append-only audit history for EvidenceSource/EvidenceItem/Claim/EvidenceClaimLink/ContradictionRecord status changes. Never overwritten; a status transition always appends a new event (same discipline as the Knowledge Graph's OwnerDecision-gated transitions and PROGRAM-004's candidate changeLog).

entityType.description: MOGO-020 Step 2 adds EVIDENCE_QUESTION so that a human adjudication of an EvidenceQuestion (accepted/rejected/uncertain) is recorded in this one existing append-only history rather than a second event system. EvidenceQuestions are created WITHOUT a lifecycle event (evidence_questions.create_question has never emitted one), so a question's genesis lifecycle event is its first 'reviewed' adjudication -- see validate_evidence._GENESIS_EVENT_TYPE_BY_ENTITY_TYPE.
